title: Basic Calculator
description: Write a program that accepts two integers and displays their sum, difference, product, and quotient.
learn_text: input(), int(), arithmetic operators, and print().
solution_code:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())
print("Sum:", a + b)
print("Difference:", a - b)
print("Product:", a * b)
print("Quotient:", a / b)

title: Swap Two Numbers
description: Read two numbers and exchange their values without using a third variable.
learn_text: Multiple assignment and split(). Python lets you swap two variables directly with a, b = b, a.
solution_code:
a, b = map(int, input().split())
print("Before swapping:", a, b)
a, b = b, a
print("After swapping:", a, b)

title: Calculate Simple Interest
description: Given the principal amount P, annual interest rate R, and time T in years (each on its own line), calculate simple interest. Formula: SI = (P x R x T) / 100
learn_text: float() and using mathematical formulas in code.
solution_code:
p = float(input())
r = float(input())
t = float(input())
si = (p * r * t) / 100
print("Simple Interest:", si)

title: Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit
description: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit. Formula: F = (9/5) x C + 32
learn_text: Arithmetic operations, variables, and type conversion.
solution_code:
c = float(input())
f = (c * 9 / 5) + 32
print("Fahrenheit:", f)

title: Sum of First N Natural Numbers
description: Calculate the sum of all natural numbers from 1 to N.
learn_text: An accumulator variable stores the running total. For the input 5, the sum is 1+2+3+4+5 = 15.
solution_code:
n = int(input())
total = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    total = total + i
print("Sum:", total)

title: Factorial of a Number
description: Calculate the factorial of a non-negative integer. Factorial means multiplying all positive integers up to that number. By definition, 0! = 1.
learn_text: Multiplication inside a loop. The variable fact starts at 1 because multiplying by 0 would make the result zero.
solution_code:
n = int(input())
fact = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    fact = fact * i
print("Factorial:", fact)

title: Count the Digits in a Number
description: Count the number of digits in a non-negative integer. Treat zero as a one-digit number.
learn_text: // performs integer division. Repeatedly dividing by 10 removes the last digit until no digits remain.

title: Reverse a Number
description: Reverse the digits of a non-negative integer.
learn_text: n % 10 extracts the last digit, and n // 10 removes it. For input 120, the reversed integer is 21 because leading zeros are not preserved.
solution_code:
n = int(input())
reverse = 0
while n > 0:
    digit = n % 10
    reverse = reverse * 10 + digit
    n = n // 10
print("Reversed number:", reverse)
